title: React comments with optimistic likes
context: Comment list with optimistic likes: the count changes at once and must be rolled back if the server rejects the like (any non-2xx) or the request fails. Comment bodies are plain text typed by users; line breaks must be kept. Comments are shown newest first (createdAt is an ISO 8601 UTC string).
